deals.headline: Block trade on NSE: Rs 20.84cr at Rs 1,986.20/share

news.headline: Board approves Rs 1,550cr NCD raise, Rs 140cr capacity addition; DRI upgrades at Ghugus (8,15,000 MTPA) and Konsari (92,400 MTPA)
Promoter NDUs disclosed: Shreekrishna Gupta 9.0cr shares (16% of his holding), Lloyds Metals & Minerals Trading LLP 1.57cr shares (2.80%) for rupee term loan; ownership/voting retained
Thriveni Earthmovers released 8 lakh pledged shares (0.14%) as collateral cover improved on price rise
Q1FY27 results: standalone PAT Rs 1,527cr (+141% YoY), EBITDA margin record 39.2%; market cap crosses Rs 1 lakh cr; 2nd pellet plant commissioned May-2026
FY26 results: standalone sales Rs 13,681cr (+104%), PAT Rs 3,194cr (+120%), CFO Rs 4,816cr; iron ore production 21.96 MnT; pellet 3.03 MnT at 100% utilisation
Starts commercial copper cathode production at 12,000 TPA DRC plant (50% stake); CY2026 guidance 10,000-12,000 tonnes
